title: done on an item with no acceptance criteria under an evaluated policy answers work_projection_invalid ("preflight completion recovery criterion is absent from the bound work revision") instead of a refusal that names the missing criteria and the remedy
outcome: done on an item with no acceptance criteria under an evaluated policy answers work_projection_invalid ("preflight completion recovery criterion is absent from the bound work revision") instead of a refusal that names the missing criteria and the remedy
acceptance: The refusal is exercised once on the live TermAl store against a migrated acceptance-less item (read-only until the owner revises) and its receipt is quoted on this item
The same call under a self-asserted policy keeps today's behaviour, and a regression test covers both policies with an acceptance-less item

`done` on a held item whose acceptance list is empty, in a project whose policy requires an acceptance evaluation, is refused with a named code (for example acceptance_criteria_required) whose reason says the item has no acceptance criteria and whose remedy names the words: `update REF --accept "criterion"` (revise), then the host evaluation, then `done`; the receipt never says work_projection_invalid or mentions a preflight recovery criterion for this case

completion.summary:
Under an evaluated acceptance policy, `done` on an item with no acceptance criteria is now refused by name. Landed as 68407d7 and installed as build 1151a5372540.
- StoreError::AcceptanceCriteriaRequired is guarded at the start of assess_on, before any recovery cause is built, so both completion paths are covered.
- Code acceptance_criteria_required. The reason names the missing criteria and the host's refusal to evaluate. The remedy names, in order, `engram work update REF --accept "criterion"`, the host evaluation, and `engram work done REF`, and the word's guidance offers the same.
- The host protocol code stays storage_error. The self-asserted policy is unchanged. A recovery cause naming an absent criterion stays work_projection_invalid.
- Tests: 3 storage tests and 1 word walk through refusal, retry, criteria, evaluation and seal.
- Docs: acceptance-evaluation.md (plus boundary row B52), cli-and-mcp.md and shipped.md.
- Live proof on the TermAl store: Termal::Fable2 ran `done` on migrated w-ce333e4d7ccf at 10:09:06Z with the installed build and got acceptance_criteria_required. The item was left unrevised and released.
- Independent evaluation 7…, recorded at 10:13Z, passed all three criteria.
